items.t: Voted for a legislative effort to temporarily suspend Ohio's State Gas Tax for 90 days.

items.t: Said she was proud to vote for the gas tax holiday because it offers immediate help to people feeling the strain of higher costs of living.
items.q: I was proud to vote for the gas tax holiday because it offers some immediate help to people in our community who are feeling the strain of higher costs of living,” said John.
